title: Jatrorrhizine retard obesity by modulating transcription factor c-Jun/c-Fos to downregulate Mmp12-mediated inflammation.
authors: Ma, Zhengcai; Li, Juan; Zhu, Jianyu; Yang, Zhipeng; Li, Xiaoduo; Wang, Hongmei; Tang, Qin; Zhou, Yuan; Manzoor, Rakia; Chen, Xiantao; Ma, Hang; Ye, Xiaoli
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小檗碱衍生物JAT通过调控转录因子c-Jun/c-Fos下调Mmp12缓解肥胖炎症，虽涉及TF-DNA结合预测与分子动力学模拟，但核心是药物作用机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: Obesity is a systemic, chronic, low-grade inflammatory disease. Nutritional obesity, in particular, is also accompanied by inflammation and metabolic disorders, which are the primary causes of malignant metabolic diseases. Rhizoma Coptidis (Coptis Chinensis Franch) (RC), a traditional Chinese medicine, is primarily used for its anti-inflammatory and anti-diarrheal properties. Our previous studies have shown that RC can reduce body weight and lower fat levels, demonstrating its potential to improve nutritional obesity.However, the effects and mechanisms of the active small molecules in RC extracts in treating obesity-induced chronic inflammation need to be further investigated. In this study, we investigated the ameliorative effect and mechanism study of the monomeric jatrorrhizine (JAT) extracted from RC on high-fat diet-induced obese mice. First, JAT could dose-dependently reduce body weight and decrease the expression of inflammatory factors such as IL6, IL1beta, and TNFalpha in the tissues of obese mice.Secondly, transcriptomics and bioinformatics studies of epididymal white adipose tissue (eWAT) identified Mmp12 as a key target through which JAT may alleviate obesity. Next, the effect of JAT on c-Jun/c-Fos promoter activity, which in turn down-regulates the transcript and protein levels of Mmp12, was analyzed and determined by qPCR, transcription factor prediction, single fluorescent promoter activity assay, Cell thermodynamic stability analysis (CETSA), molecular dynamics simulation mimicry, circular dichroism (CD) and Co-Immunoprecipitation (Co-IP). In conclusion, JAT may ameliorate high-fat diet-induced obesity and its associated inflammation through the c-Jun/c-Fos-Mmp12 axis.
abstract_zh: 肥胖是一种系统性、慢性、低度炎症性疾病。营养性肥胖尤其还伴随炎症和代谢紊乱，这些是恶性代谢疾病的主要原因。黄连（Coptis Chinensis Franch）(RC) 作为一种传统中药，主要用于其抗炎和止泻特性。我们先前的研究表明，RC 能降低体重和脂肪水平，显示出其改善营养性肥胖的潜力。然而，RC 提取物中活性小分子在治疗肥胖诱导的慢性炎症中的效果和机制仍需进一步研究。在本研究中，我们探讨了从 RC 中提取的单体药根碱 (jatrorrhizine, JAT) 对高脂饮食诱导的肥胖小鼠的改善效果及其机制研究。首先，JAT 能剂量依赖性地降低肥胖小鼠的体重，并减少其组织中炎症因子如 IL6、IL1beta 和 TNFalpha 的表达。其次，对附睾白色脂肪组织 (eWAT) 的转录组学和生物信息学研究确定了 Mmp12 是 JAT 可能缓解肥胖的关键靶点。接着，通过 qPCR、转录因子预测、单荧光启动子活性测定、细胞热稳定性分析 (CETSA)、分子动力学模拟、圆二色谱 (CD) 和免疫共沉淀 (Co-IP) 分析并确定了 JAT 对 c-Jun/c-Fos 启动子活性的影响，进而下调 Mmp12 的转录和蛋白水平。总之，JAT 可能通过 c-Jun/c-Fos-Mmp12 轴改善高脂饮食诱导的肥胖及其相关炎症。
